clause: Threaded / linked text: flow modes, smart reflow, linked stories [STU-TYP-005]

scope.summary: Implement threaded area stories so one logical story flows across containers, pages, and StudioPageSpreads with an overset indicator. Placement flow modes: manual flow, semi-autoflow (one container, cursor reloaded), autoflow (add containers/pages until story ends), fixed-page autoflow (fill existing pages only) (InDesign thread-text + autoflow). Smart-reflow MAY add/remove StudioPageSpread pages as a threaded story grows/shrinks, scoped to primary containers or all containers (Smart Text Reflow). Linked stories: a child story mirrors a parent with update/warn-on-change status (linked stories).
proof_targets: threaded flow + autoflow + smart-reflow runtime test
expected_tests: live: story flows across threaded containers/spreads with overset; manual/semi-auto/auto/fixed-page flow modes
test: smart-reflow adds/removes StudioPageSpread pages; linked-story mirror + warn-on-change status
acceptance_criteria_original: threaded stories; 4 flow modes; smart page reflow; linked stories with status; overset indicator

spec_clauses.spec_clause_text: [STU-TYP-005] Threaded / linked text: multiple `area` stories MAY be threaded so a single logical story flows across containers, pages, and spreads with an overset indicator. Placement flow modes MUST cover manual flow, semi-autoflow (one container, cursor reloaded), autoflow (add containers/pages until story ends), and fixed-page autoflow (fill existing pages only) (provenance: InDesign thread-text + autoflow modes). Smart-reflow MAY add or remove `StudioPageSpread` pages as a threaded story grows or shrinks, scoped to primary containers or all containers (provenance: InDesign Smart Text Reflow). Linked stories (a child story that mirrors a parent story with update/warn-on-change status) are supported as a story-link relation (provenance: InDesign linked stories).

implementation_notes.naming: Vendor product names are provenance only. Studio ships Handshake-native names per [STU-SECTION-003].
implementation_notes.database: SurrealDB with the EventLedger is the only durable authority. SQLite, libSQL, Turso and PostgreSQL are forbidden, including in tests and dev caches.
implementation_notes.engine_split: GPU, WGSL and compute live in the studio-engine crate behind its traits. handshake_core must never gain a GPU dependency.
implementation_notes.routing: Navigation extends the existing address and bus seams. No new router.
implementation_notes.worktree: Code paths resolve against the WP-KERNEL-012 worktree, never main.

validator_focus: Confirm every acceptance row traces to a sentence in the cited spec clause carried in implementation_notes. A row with no spec basis is a fabrication.
Reject any row still carrying proof_target_status REQUIRED: it has no proof of its own.
Reject scaffold-only proof: at least one proof command must drive the executable runtime rather than a fixture the implementer authored.
Where the contract touches numeric parameters, confirm hard and soft bounds are stored as separate values and an unknown bound is stored as unknown, never mirrored.

resource_privacy_obligation.rule: Resources this contract reads, derives, caches or exports stay inside the authenticated operator's scope. No cross-identity read path may be introduced.

patch_provenance.preserved: The original acceptance prose is kept verbatim at scope.acceptance_criteria_original. No clause, scope decision, path list or obligation from the original contract was removed.
